focus: CleanupEffecters(keepTracked) in the fog/off-map branch of MapComponent_TitanVisuals and the trackedMap bookkeeping
diffSource: since build 11 (2026-10-05T22:19:30Z), the last reviewed build, from the build log

findings.title: Refresh-path CleanupEffecters() still nulls trackedMap while the titan stays tracked
findings.detail: EffectersTick's periodic refresh calls CleanupEffecters() with the default, which sets trackedMap = null even though the titan stays in the component's tracked list and respawns its effecters on the next line. The next TickInterval then sees trackedMap != pawn.Map and calls Track again; Contains skips the duplicate, so nothing breaks, but it is the same bookkeeping inconsistency keepTracked was added to avoid. Pass keepTracked: true at Hediff_Titan.cs:183 so trackedMap means 'in that map's tracked list' everywhere.

findings.title: Fog/off-map cleanup hides the off-centre bug rather than fixing its cause
findings.detail: The comment says misplaced particles lasted 'until the trait was reapplied'. Cleaning up on every fogged or off-map tick means a rebuild each time the titan is revealed or the player switches back to its map. Any effecter def whose sub-effecters burst on spawn will now replay that burst on every switch, and the underlying offset bug (possibly in SpawnAttached or EffectTick targeting) is not explained. This is my opinion only; there is no runtime evidence either way.

findings.title: Invisible titans lose their flames entirely; vanilla draws invisible bodies with an invisibility material
findings.detail: For the player's own psychically invisible pawns, vanilla swaps materials to InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat (except in portraits) instead of skipping the draw. The new early return hides the flames while the body is still drawn faintly. Wrapping mat with InvisibilityMatPool.GetInvisibleMat when the Invisible flag is set would match vanilla, if that is the intended look.

findings.title: The example defs no longer demonstrate a hidden trait with visuals
findings.detail: Removing the overlay from TF_Example_Venomous leaves showVisualsWhenHidden (TitanTraitDef.cs:126) with no example among the shipped example defs. Nothing else in the mod references the removed block, so this is a loss of documentation only.
